1  nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring the action of the Respondents in taking sleps to dispossess the petitioners from their respective agricultural lands in an extent of Ac.5.00 cents situated in Sy.No.362-03-A AND Sy.No. 362-2-A-1 of Koduru Village, Anakapalli Mandal, Anakapalli District, on the ground of allotting house- site pattas to the beneficiaries, without issuing any notice,

sentences.text: Petition under Section 151 CPC is filed praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the Respondents not to dispossess th4 Petitioners from their respective agriculture lands in an extent of Ac.5.00 cents situated in Sy.No.362-03-A & Sy.No. 362-2-A-1 of Koduru Village, Anakapalli Mandal, Anakapalli District, without following due process of law.
Pending disposal of WP 31693 of 2025, on the file of the High Court.

The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the affidavit filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of K SIVA RAMA KRISHNA KOLLURU Advocate for the Petitioners, GP for Revenue for the Respondent Nos. 1 to 4 and the Court made the following ORDER The present writ petition is filed declaring the action of the respondents in taking steps to dispossess the petitioners from their respective agricultural lands in an extent of Ac.5.00 cents situated in Survey No.362-03-A & Survey No.362-2-A-1 of Koduru Village, Anakapalli Mandal, Anakapalli District, without following due process of law, as illegal and arbitrary.

Considering the submissions and on perusal of the record, this Court has granted two days time to the learned Government Pleader to get instructions.
Despite granting time, learned Government Pleader is not placed any instructions.

In view of the same, there shall a direction to the respondents not to interfere and not to dispossess the petitioners from the subject lands without following due process of law.
List the matter after Pongal Vacation, 2026.
